dict.string: SHOMER shows you on the community map so the nearest guardian can reach you, and sends your location with an SOS.
SHOMER needs your location in the background so your SOS still reaches nearby guardians when your screen is off or another app is open.
SHOMER needs your location in the background so your SOS still reaches nearby guardians when your screen is off or another app is open.
SHOMER uses your contacts only to let you pick who to invite as your personal SHOMER. Nothing is uploaded.
SHOMER uses the microphone for hands-free voice commands during an emergency.
SHOMER recognises spoken commands so you can trigger help without touching the screen.
SHOMER detects a hard shake of your phone as a silent way to raise an SOS.
SHOMER uses the camera only when you choose to attach a photo to an incident report.
